centre.source: Koch et al. (2018), Table 2: Centre R.A. 23.4607 ± 0.0042°, Centre Dec. 30.6583 ± 0.0032°, from the same DiskFit fit

choice: One flat plane from Koch et al. (2018, Table 2): DiskFit's fit of a rotating disc to the VLA+GBT H I peak-velocity surface (39,970 points), which covers the star-forming disc where these catalogues lie. The position angle is the receding side's, measured from north through east; the line of nodes is 21.12° from north.
limits: A single plane. Corbelli et al. (2014) find the H I disc warps beyond the optical disc, its line of nodes turning toward M31; dots placed on this plane inherit that error, largest for the outer planetary nebulae. The erratum to Koch et al. (2018, MNRAS 480, 3193) was not read: its publisher page is behind a browser challenge. The values above are from arXiv:1806.11218v2 (2018-08-08).
